baseline.policy: 100% active cash-feasible core on the exact three classic calendars.

execution_envelope.capacity_constraint: total satellite <=10% NAV, each mechanism bucket <=5% NAV, null 100% core allowed, source/ticker concentration disclosed
execution_envelope.costs_and_carry: inherit the frozen 45bp round-trip candidate paths and cash-feasible core costs; no leverage or financing credit
execution_envelope.execution_dependency: exact frozen daily paths, deterministic grid, nonnegative capital weights, no production orders
execution_envelope.intended_instrument: existing long-only U.S. cash-equity strategy sleeves in a research replay
execution_envelope.liquidity_dependency: inherit each frozen strategy's own eligibility; no new ticker or fill rule
execution_envelope.timing_constraint: weights are static inside each evaluation window; chronological walk-forward fitting only

gap.selection_contract: all 480 surfaces to eight frozen mechanism buckets; equal weight within bucket; 0-10% total satellite; 1% exhaustive grid; 0.25% local refinement; no outcome-ranked strategy inclusion

expectation_gap.gap_definition: A capital-neutral joint satellite is valuable only if its diversification benefit exceeds the opportunity cost of displaced cash-feasible core capital.

independent_evidence.claim: 480 unique frozen long strategy paths can be reconstructed on identical classic calendars.
196 settled forward rows across 21 current sleeves provide a recent observe-only contradiction check.

transmission.expected_direction: positive funded aggregate EV and PnL delta with bounded risk
transmission.half_life: six-month classic windows with recent forward stability check

candidate.expected_horizon: old_thin, mid_weak, late_strong; recent 2026-05-05 through 2026-08-14 observe-only
candidate.falsifier: Reject unless a capital-neutral vector improves aggregate classic-window EV and PnL versus 100% core, has at most one material window regression under Gate 4-P, worsens max drawdown by no more than 0.5pp and ES95 by no more than 5%, passes chronological walk-forward checks, respects 10% total satellite and concentration caps, and is not contradicted by mapped recent forward replacement value. Any positive result remains observed_only.

fingerprint.horizon: old_thin, mid_weak, late_strong; recent 2026-05-05 through 2026-08-14 observe-only

candidate.hypothesis: Equalizing the influence of eight outcome-blind source-mechanism buckets and exhaustively allocating at most 10% of capital across their aggregate return paths can combine differently timed strategy cashflows into higher classic-window expected value than the full cash-feasible core, while recent settled forward rows should not contradict the selected source mix.

prediction.confidence_reason: A joint covariance shape is economically distinct from the failed single-sleeve lane, but the cash-feasible core is strong, the classic panel is adaptively reused, and recent forward sleeve results are immature; a robust positive allocation is plausible but unlikely.

candidate.reopen_condition: If rejected, do not retune bucket definitions, capital grid, total budget, objective or recent mapping on the same frozen paths. Reopen only with a prospective pre-frozen joint portfolio ledger, a materially new strategy family, or an owner-authorized execution/risk gate shape backed by new evidence.
candidate.replacement_value_comparator: 100% cash-feasible core primary; core plus the same unallocated satellite budget held as zero-return cash secondary diagnostic.
candidate.title: Capital-neutral hierarchical joint strategy allocator

treatment.policy: Consider all 480 frozen long surfaces; map them deterministically into eight source-mechanism buckets; equal-weight unique paths inside each bucket; enumerate every 1% capital vector with total satellite <=10%, retain the null, refine around the best feasible point at 0.25%, and never use the recent cohort in formal Gate arithmetic.

candidate.why_not_arbitraged: The repository accumulated many individually tested strategies, but capital displacement and covariance were historically evaluated one sleeve at a time. Joint funding can expose diversification that standalone champion comparisons miss, while capacity, costs, regime correlation and estimation error can erase it.

decision.rationale: The owner explicitly requested all-strategy combination optimization. A single predeclared hierarchical gate shape can answer it without retuning individual strategies or granting live authority.

researchability.basis: The repository has 480 hash-frozen replayable long surfaces, exact classic-window OHLCV, a cash-feasible core comparator, and 196 recent settled forward rows. The joint gate shape is new, but historical selection incompleteness and uneven forward maturity cap the result at observed_only.
limitations: The original adaptive strategy-selection history is incomplete.
Classic windows were reused by prior experiments and are not untouched holdouts.
Recent paper data are settled-trade cashflows rather than complete daily MTM portfolio paths.
A research result cannot change live/default strategy weights or orders.

business_analyst.conclusion: TEST one capital-neutral joint allocator. The economic question is portfolio opportunity cost: every satellite dollar must cover displaced core return, and the exact grid includes the null 100% core allocation.

evidence.claim: The active comparator is the frozen cash-feasible core across all three classic windows.
The complete prior single-sleeve portfolio lane cannot answer whether several sources diversify each other inside one fixed budget.

business_analyst.uncertainty: A bucket average can dilute a real edge, while a more granular optimizer would raise overfitting and multiple-testing risk.

financial_analyst.conclusion: TEST only with a 0-10% satellite budget, exact cash conservation, 45bp strategy costs already embedded in frozen paths, 1% global enumeration, 0.25% local refinement, and explicit core displacement accounting.

evidence.claim: The historical manifest freezes 480 unique long surfaces and their exact source hashes.
The active core baseline maintains nonnegative execution-date cash in every classic window.
Gate 4-P requires capital-neutral comparison, bounded drawdown and tail risk, and formal comparison against 100% core.

financial_analyst.uncertainty: The discrete optimum is exact only inside the declared bucket taxonomy and capital grid, not an unknowable global optimum over arbitrary future policies.

industry_researcher.conclusion: TEST. This is not an industry bet; eight source-mechanism buckets and equal weighting within bucket are required so trial-rich OHLCV, Companyfacts, or SEC families cannot dominate merely through enumeration count.

evidence.claim: The recoverable panel spans OHLCV relation/momentum, Companyfacts, SEC ownership/text, allocator, revisions, flow, positioning, macro and other mechanisms.
Repository governance requires mechanism-first cross-surface synthesis rather than a post-hoc winner list.

industry_researcher.uncertainty: The broad other bucket is heterogeneous; any positive result must report its constituent concentration and may not be described as an independent factor.

risk_assessor.conclusion: TEST research-only. Reject unless aggregate EV and PnL both improve versus full core, at most one window materially regresses, drawdown and ES95 caps pass, walk-forward folds pass, and no source or ticker concentration cap is breached. Recent forward evidence remains a diagnostic veto on interpretation, not a Gate acceptance input.

evidence.claim: The prior all-surface Gate 4-P audit found selection-history incompleteness and zero simultaneous lower-bound passes, so any retrospective allocation result must remain observed_only.
The recent forward ledger contains 196 settled rows across 21 sleeves through 2026-08-14, sufficient for diagnosis but not complete daily portfolio inference.

risk_assessor.uncertainty: Covariance estimation and reused windows can make an apparent optimum unstable; the null 100% core allocation must remain admissible.

subject.research_question: Can an outcome-blind hierarchical allocation across every recoverable strategy surface improve the funded cash-feasible core across the three classic windows without failing recent forward diagnostics?
